messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: stat_vline's arguments intercept and xintercept
parts:
Hi,

I tired to use both intercept and xintercept of stat_vline. But none
of them works. Could you let me know what is the correct way to use
stat_vline?

> library(ggplot2)
Loading required package: reshape
Loading required package: plyr

Attaching package: 'reshape'

The following object(s) are masked from 'package:plyr':

round_any

Loading required package: grid
Loading required package: proto
> adf=data.frame(x=1:10, y=1:10)
> ggplot(data=adf, mapping=aes(x=x, y=y))+layer(geom='point')+stat_vline(xintercept=5)
Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, geom = geom, :
argument "intercept" is missing, with no default
> ggplot(data=adf, mapping=aes(x=x, y=y))+layer(geom='point')+stat_vline(intercept=5)
Error in get(x, envir = this, inherits = inh)(this, ...) :
stat_vline now uses xintercept instead of intercept


--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: stat_vline's arguments intercept and xintercept
parts:
On 4/13/2011 8:19 AM, Peng Yu wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I tired to use both intercept and xintercept of stat_vline. But none
> of them works. Could you let me know what is the correct way to use
> stat_vline?
>
>> library(ggplot2)
> Loading required package: reshape
> Loading required package: plyr
>
> Attaching package: 'reshape'
>
> The following object(s) are masked from 'package:plyr':
>
> round_any
>
> Loading required package: grid
> Loading required package: proto
>> adf=data.frame(x=1:10, y=1:10)
>> ggplot(data=adf, mapping=aes(x=x, y=y))+layer(geom='point')+stat_vline(xintercept=5)
> Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, geom = geom, :
> argument "intercept" is missing, with no default
>> ggplot(data=adf, mapping=aes(x=x, y=y))+layer(geom='point')+stat_vline(intercept=5)
> Error in get(x, envir = this, inherits = inh)(this, ...) :
> stat_vline now uses xintercept instead of intercept

If you change stat_vline to geom_vline (with the xintercept argument),
it works. Don't know why it does not work with stat_vline.
